title: Fix missing Admin Panel navigation link in Layout

requirements.summary: Add a visible 'Admin Panel' navigation link to Layout.tsx that is conditionally rendered for admin users and appears in both desktop and mobile navigation without requiring overflow menu interaction
acceptanceCriteria: When logged in as an admin user, an 'Admin Panel' link is visible in the main navigation header.
The link is also present in the mobile menu for admin users.
Clicking the link navigates to the /admin route which renders AdminPanel.tsx.
Non-admin authenticated users do not see the Admin Panel link.
Unauthenticated users do not see the Admin Panel link.

file_operations.description: Add an 'Admin Panel' navigation link to both the desktop navigation (main nav element) and mobile menu that is conditionally rendered using the useIsCallerAdmin hook. Move the Admin Panel link from the overflow dropdown menu into the main visible navigation areas. Ensure the link uses the Link component from @tanstack/react-router to navigate to '/admin'. The admin check must follow the existing pattern in the codebase using the useIsCallerAdmin hook from hooks/useQueries.ts. The link must be positioned in the primary navigation alongside Home, About, Events, etc., not hidden in any overflow or dropdown menu.
